headline: Low interaction risk overall: no shared channels or writes are documented, so prompt injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are largely absent.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile documents a shared communication channel, filesystem bridge, MCP server, or clipboard path. agent_a is non-runnable with no I/O surfaces, and agent_b likewise shows no I/O surfaces or network egress. With no documented ingestion path, prompt injection between them is not plausible.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared copy-paste workflows.
Do not mount a common workspace between them.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: No data classes are listed for either agent, and both profiles show network_egress: none. There is no documented shared workspace, OAuth principal, or upload path, so there is no evident route for sensitive data to leave one agent through the other.
conditions: IF either agent is given access to sensitive files or an outbound connector, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
requires-engineering: add explicit data-class allowlists before enabling connectors.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both profiles expose no write surfaces, no concurrency model, and no network egress. Without overlapping mutable resources, there is no documented capability conflict between agent_a and agent_b.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory or mutable resource, conflict risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Avoid giving both agents write access to the same path.
Keep them read-only in shared environments.
requires-engineering: introduce locking if shared mutation is added.

D_cascading_error.rationale: agent_a is an awesome-list repository and agent_b is a game-playing RL repository; neither profile shows action-taking authority or a documented pipeline where B consumes A's outputs as authoritative. Any cascade would require an unusual external orchestration, so the blast radius is small and indirect.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding agent_a outputs directly into agent_b decisions without verification, cascading error risk appears.
mitigations: Insert a human review step between outputs and actions.
Do not auto-forward A's text into B's prompts.
requires-engineering: add validation checks before downstream use.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either agent. Because the profiles do not show PHI, EU PII, or retention policies, there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data or a jurisdiction-specific deployment, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Record retention settings for any future logs.
requires-engineering: map regulated data flows before use.
